scenes.title: Follow the main navigation
scenes.caption: Click Learn in the sidebar, then return Home. The six core destinations stay available without scrolling.

scenes.title: Use your learning path
scenes.caption: Click Modules to inspect the next part of the learning path, then return Home. Progress bars reflect completed lessons.

scenes.title: Find secondary sections
scenes.caption: Open More resources and choose Tools. The separate account menu contains profile and settings. Pro tools are shown in this demonstration account.

scenes.title: Open a lesson
scenes.caption: Click Learn, choose Lessons, and open the first lesson. The Sprout opening introduces the topic before the concepts appear.

scenes.title: Work through the material
scenes.caption: Click Next slide to see the example, then open the practice prompt and summary. Underlined words open definitions.

scenes.title: Complete the quiz
scenes.caption: Click Start quiz, choose an answer, and check it. Work through all five questions. At least four correct answers are needed to pass.

title: Explore a module and its quiz

scenes.title: Expand a module
scenes.caption: Click Modules, expand Market Basics, and choose its presentation. The module groups related lessons together.

scenes.title: Explore each part
scenes.caption: Use Concepts, Examples, and Practice and summary within a module lesson. Next slide moves to the next lesson in the module.

scenes.title: Review before the quiz
scenes.caption: Continue through the module presentation, then choose Start quiz. You can review the presentation before submitting answers.

title: Buy and sell in the simulator

scenes.title: Open the trading screen
scenes.caption: Click Simulator and select Apple. Read the generated candlestick chart and the current virtual quote before placing an order.

scenes.title: Review a buy order
scenes.caption: Enter one share, click Review buy, and inspect the quantity, estimated cost, and remaining virtual cash.

scenes.title: Confirm the purchase
scenes.caption: Click Confirm buy. Read the trade breakdown, then close it to return to the chart and your position.

scenes.title: Sell the position
scenes.caption: Select Sell, enter one share, review the order, and confirm the sale. The breakdown explains the completed virtual trade.

scenes.title: Read your progress
scenes.caption: Click Progress. Review completed lessons, modules, and your learning streak before choosing your next learning step.

scenes.title: Browse achievements
scenes.caption: Click Achievements and move to the next page of badges. Earned and locked rewards remain clearly separated.

scenes.title: Set a learning reminder
scenes.caption: Open Habits and goals and choose a daily reminder time. Download the calendar file and import it into your own calendar to activate it.

title: Search terms and play study games

scenes.title: Look up a term
scenes.caption: Click Glossary, search for VWAP, and expand its definition to read the worked example.

scenes.title: Use flashcards
scenes.caption: Open Study games. Reveal a flashcard, read the definition, and mark whether you know it.

scenes.title: Try matching
scenes.caption: Select Matching, choose a term, then choose a definition. Correct matches remain marked while you complete the round.

title: Position size calculator: enter a plan

scenes.title: Open the calculator
scenes.caption: Open More resources, choose Tools, and select Position size. This is a Pro tool; the walkthrough uses a demonstration account.

scenes.title: Enter your inputs
scenes.caption: Set a practice budget of one thousand dollars, a one percent risk limit, a one hundred dollar entry, and a ninety eight dollar stop.

scenes.title: Read the share size
scenes.caption: Read the resulting five-share estimate and expand the tool guide. The size is a planning calculation and does not place a trade.

title: Risk calculator: adjust the loss limit

scenes.title: Find the risk tool
scenes.caption: Open Tools and select Risk. The risk calculator shares its practice budget with the position size calculator.

scenes.title: Adjust the percentage
scenes.caption: Move the risk slider from one percent to two percent and watch the dollar risk budget change. This does not guarantee an executed stop price.

scenes.title: Compare position size
scenes.caption: Return to Position size and read the updated risk setting and share estimate. Revisit the assumptions before a practice order.

title: Profit and loss explorer: compare exits

scenes.title: Open the explorer
scenes.caption: Open Tools and select Profit and loss. Inputs from Position size define the hypothetical share quantity and entry.

scenes.title: Change the exit
scenes.caption: Move the exit slider above the entry price and compare the potential gain with the planned loss at the stop.

scenes.title: Test a losing exit
scenes.caption: Move the exit below entry and read the negative result. These are planning examples, not predictions or actual orders.

scenes.title: Find the meter
scenes.caption: Open Tools and choose Volatility. This gauge measures variability in generated SPY price changes.

scenes.title: Read the guide
scenes.caption: Expand How to use this tool and read what the percentage represents. A higher reading is not a buy or sell instruction.

scenes.title: Apply the context
scenes.caption: Return to Position size to consider your planned risk. Volatility is one input in a decision process, not a direction forecast.

scenes.title: Open the Practice Lab
scenes.caption: Choose Practice Lab from More resources. Open Chart practice to inspect a scenario before making a choice. Pro practice features are shown here.

scenes.title: Choose a response
scenes.caption: Select one of the scenario responses and read the feedback. The purpose is to explain your reasoning, not guess a guaranteed outcome.

scenes.title: Choose a challenge
scenes.caption: Open Challenges and start a three-trade reflection challenge. Progress is based on completing and reviewing practice, not chasing a profit target.

scenes.title: Open the portfolio
scenes.caption: Choose Portfolio from More resources. Read virtual account value, available cash, and total return.

scenes.title: Inspect a holding
scenes.caption: After a practice purchase, open Portfolio again and inspect the holdings row, quantity, current value, and gain or loss.

scenes.title: Return to the chart
scenes.caption: Open the Apple holding to return to its chart. Check your order and position before making another practice decision.

scenes.title: Open trade history
scenes.caption: After a virtual buy and sell, choose Trade History from More resources. Both fills appear in the completed-trades table.

scenes.title: Inspect the trade
scenes.caption: Use Explain My Trade to review a completed fill and read its breakdown before returning to the record.

scenes.title: Open the journal
scenes.caption: Use Open trade journal and analytics to reflect on the reasoning behind your trade.

title: Write and save a trade reflection

scenes.title: Find a completed trade
scenes.caption: Open Practice Lab and choose Journal. Select the completed virtual trade you want to review.

scenes.title: Write the reflection
scenes.caption: Enter why you took the trade, what could invalidate the idea, and what you learned. Choose the emotion that best describes the decision.

scenes.title: Save the note
scenes.caption: Save the journal entry and review the saved feedback. Keep notes specific enough to improve your next practice decision.

title: Browse community and prepare a post

scenes.title: Open Community
scenes.caption: Choose Community from More resources. Switch between discussions, strategies, chart competition, and leaderboards.

scenes.title: Prepare a discussion
scenes.caption: Return to Discussions and enter a clear title and explanation. This example prepares a draft without publishing to real users.

scenes.title: Review public sharing
scenes.caption: Open Leaderboards to inspect the sharing controls. Sharing a portfolio snapshot is optional, and virtual account value is not a measure of trading skill.

title: Edit your profile and review insights

scenes.title: Open your profile
scenes.caption: Open Account and settings, then choose Profile. Your profile brings identity, learning progress, and simulator insights together.

scenes.title: Update the display name
scenes.caption: Edit the display name in Profile details and save the profile. The demonstration uses a sample account, not a real customer.

scenes.title: Review learning growth
scenes.caption: Scroll to Your learning growth to review completed modules, lessons, and learning habits.

scenes.title: Find Settings
scenes.caption: Open Account and settings, then click Settings. Read the practice preferences before changing them.

scenes.title: Toggle beginner explanations
scenes.caption: Switch Beginner Mode off and on to control additional order explanations. This does not change the five-question quiz pass requirement.

scenes.title: Switch the display theme
scenes.caption: Use the theme control in the top bar to switch between light and dark. Account security controls remain separate from practice settings.

scenes.title: Open plan comparison
scenes.caption: Choose Sprout Pro from More resources. Compare the Starter and Pro feature lists before considering an upgrade.

scenes.title: Read the comparison
scenes.caption: Review included lessons, tutorials, practice tools, and simulator features. Video walkthroughs do not unlock the Pro tools themselves.

scenes.title: Review cancellation information
scenes.caption: Read the cancellation and subscription information. This walkthrough does not enter payment details or start a paid subscription.

scenes.title: Open Tutorials
scenes.caption: Open Learn and select Tutorials. Platform walkthroughs and trading lessons have separate categories.

scenes.title: Filter walkthroughs
scenes.caption: Use the section filter to find Tools or Simulator guides. Browse a page of videos without expanding a long list.

scenes.title: Use captions and transcripts
scenes.caption: Open a guide and use its video controls, English captions, and transcript. Videos play only when you choose to start them.

scenes.title: Find chart controls
scenes.caption: Open the simulator chart and change the candle interval. Zoom in to inspect a smaller section of generated price action.

scenes.title: Explore an indicator
scenes.caption: Open Indicators and select a moving average. Pro chart tools are demonstrated here; availability depends on your plan.

scenes.title: Use the chart tour
scenes.caption: Open Sprouty’s chart tour and advance through a step. The tour explains how the controls relate to reading a chart.
